title: Pip Listens for Home
checkpoint: Reception Summer 2, week 3 — Phase 4: Three consonants together: three consonant sounds together (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4, 73-sound stage (nd, nt, nk just added).

pages.illustration: Leaves and twigs blowing hard across the garden in a strong wind.

pages.text: Pip can not see the nest.

pages.text: Grit and dust spin in the wind.

Pip the sparrow standing firm on a branch, steadying himself in the wind.

pages.text: A quack rings out near the pond.
pages.illustration: Sound-ripple lines spreading out from the direction of the pond towards Pip.
Pip the sparrow hopping quickly towards the sound, wings half out.
Pip the sparrow arriving back at his twiggy nest at last.

pages.text: Pip and Ned rest in the nest.
